verdict.rationale: Proa documents modular, composable typed Rust components: vendored into src/components, composed, with compile-time-checked props. Every render also gets typed access to request-scoped data, route state and loader caching through a shared WebContext, which is context passing rather than a documented dependency-injection system. missing for 10: an explicit dependency-injection mechanism (providers/injectors or service registration), module-level organization beyond components, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
